import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
from scipy import stats

# 1. Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Aggregate at transect level
tran = (
    df.groupby(['id_reef', 'year', 'depth', 'transect'])
      .agg(biomass_total=('biomass', 'sum'), prod_total=('prod', 'sum'), area=('area', 'first'))
      .reset_index()
)
tran['biomass_density'] = tran['biomass_total'] / tran['area']
tran['prod_density'] = tran['prod_total'] / tran['area']

# Prepare data vectors
x = tran['biomass_density'].values
y = tran['prod_density'].values
n = len(y)

# 3a. Fit linear model: prod_density ~ biomass_density
X_lin = sm.add_constant(x)
lin_mod = sm.OLS(y, X_lin).fit()
slope = lin_mod.params[1]
intercept = lin_mod.params[0]
print("Linear Model:")
print(f"  Intercept = {intercept:.4f}, Slope = {slope:.4f}")
print(f"  R-squared = {lin_mod.rsquared:.3f}")

# 3b. Fit Michaelis-Menten model: prod = Vmax * x / (Km + x)
def mm_model(b, Vmax, Km):
    return Vmax * b / (Km + b)
# initial parameter guesses
p0 = [y.max(), np.median(x)]
params, cov = curve_fit(mm_model, x, y, p0=p0, maxfev=5000)
Vmax, Km = params
se = np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
df_err = n - len(params)
t_stats = params / se
p_vals = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_stats), df_err))
print("\nMichaelis-Menten Model:")
print(f"  Vmax = {Vmax:.4f} (SE = {se[0]:.4f}, p = {p_vals[0]:.4g})")
print(f"  Km   = {Km:.4f} (SE = {se[1]:.4f}, p = {p_vals[1]:.4g})")

# 4. Compare by AIC
aic_lin = lin_mod.aic
rss_mm = np.sum((y - mm_model(x, Vmax, Km))**2)
k_mm = len(params)
aic_mm = 2 * k_mm + n * np.log(rss_mm / n)
print(f"\nAIC Comparison:")
print(f"  Linear model AIC          = {aic_lin:.1f}")
print(f"  Michaelis-Menten model AIC = {aic_mm:.1f}")

# 5. Residual diagnostics
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
# Linear residuals
axes[0].scatter(lin_mod.fittedvalues, lin_mod.resid, alpha=0.3)
axes[0].hlines(0, lin_mod.fittedvalues.min(), lin_mod.fittedvalues.max(), colors='red')
axes[0].set_title('Linear Model Residuals')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Fitted values')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Residuals')
# MM residuals
y_mm_fit = mm_model(x, Vmax, Km)
axes[1].scatter(y_mm_fit, y - y_mm_fit, alpha=0.3)
axes[1].hlines(0, y_mm_fit.min(), y_mm_fit.max(), colors='red')
axes[1].set_title('Michaelis-Menten Residuals')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Fitted values')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Residuals')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 6. Plot observed and fitted curves
x_line = np.linspace(x.min(), x.max(), 200)
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(x, y, s=10, alpha=0.3, label='Observed')
plt.plot(x_line, intercept + slope * x_line, color='C1', lw=2, label='Linear fit')
plt.plot(x_line, mm_model(x_line, Vmax, Km), color='C2', lw=2, label='Michaelis-Menten fit')
plt.xlabel('Biomass density (biomass/area)')
plt.ylabel('Productivity density (prod/area)')
plt.title('Productivity vs Biomass Density')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

# 7. Conclusion
print("Conclusion:")
better = 'Michaelis-Menten' if aic_mm < aic_lin else 'Linear'
print(f"  The {better} model has lower AIC, indicating a better fit.")
if better == 'Michaelis-Menten':
    print("  This suggests productivity density exhibits a saturating (decelerating) relationship with biomass density.")
else:
    print("  This suggests productivity density increases linearly with biomass density.")

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
from scipy import stats

# 1. Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Aggregate at transect level
tran = (
    df.groupby(['id_reef', 'year', 'depth', 'transect'])
      .agg(biomass_total=('biomass', 'sum'), prod_total=('prod', 'sum'), area=('area', 'first'))
      .reset_index()
)
tran['biomass_density'] = tran['biomass_total'] / tran['area']
tran['prod_density'] = tran['prod_total'] / tran['area']

# Prepare data vectors
x = tran['biomass_density'].values
y = tran['prod_density'].values
n = len(y)

# 3a. Fit linear model: prod_density ~ biomass_density
X_lin = sm.add_constant(x)
lin_mod = sm.OLS(y, X_lin).fit()
slope = lin_mod.params[1]
intercept = lin_mod.params[0]
print("Linear Model:")
print(f"  Intercept = {intercept:.4f}, Slope = {slope:.4f}")
print(f"  R-squared = {lin_mod.rsquared:.3f}")

# 3b. Fit Michaelis-Menten model: prod = Vmax * x / (Km + x)
def mm_model(b, Vmax, Km):
    return Vmax * b / (Km + b)
# initial parameter guesses
p0 = [y.max(), np.median(x)]
params, cov = curve_fit(mm_model, x, y, p0=p0, maxfev=5000)
Vmax, Km = params
se = np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
df_err = n - len(params)
t_stats = params / se
p_vals = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_stats), df_err))
print("\nMichaelis-Menten Model:")
print(f"  Vmax = {Vmax:.4f} (SE = {se[0]:.4f}, p = {p_vals[0]:.4g})")
print(f"  Km   = {Km:.4f} (SE = {se[1]:.4f}, p = {p_vals[1]:.4g})")

# 4. Compare by AIC
aic_lin = lin_mod.aic
rss_mm = np.sum((y - mm_model(x, Vmax, Km))**2)
k_mm = len(params)
aic_mm = 2 * k_mm + n * np.log(rss_mm / n)
print(f"\nAIC Comparison:")
print(f"  Linear model AIC          = {aic_lin:.1f}")
print(f"  Michaelis-Menten model AIC = {aic_mm:.1f}")

# 5. Residual diagnostics
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
# Linear residuals
axes[0].scatter(lin_mod.fittedvalues, lin_mod.resid, alpha=0.3)
axes[0].hlines(0, lin_mod.fittedvalues.min(), lin_mod.fittedvalues.max(), colors='red')
axes[0].set_title('Linear Model Residuals')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Fitted values')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Residuals')
# MM residuals
y_mm_fit = mm_model(x, Vmax, Km)
axes[1].scatter(y_mm_fit, y - y_mm_fit, alpha=0.3)
axes[1].hlines(0, y_mm_fit.min(), y_mm_fit.max(), colors='red')
axes[1].set_title('Michaelis-Menten Residuals')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Fitted values')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Residuals')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 6. Plot observed and fitted curves
x_line = np.linspace(x.min(), x.max(), 200)
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(x, y, s=10, alpha=0.3, label='Observed')
plt.plot(x_line, intercept + slope * x_line, color='C1', lw=2, label='Linear fit')
plt.plot(x_line, mm_model(x_line, Vmax, Km), color='C2', lw=2, label='Michaelis-Menten fit')
plt.xlabel('Biomass density (biomass/area)')
plt.ylabel('Productivity density (prod/area)')
plt.title('Productivity vs Biomass Density')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

# 7. Conclusion
print("Conclusion:")
better = 'Michaelis-Menten' if aic_mm < aic_lin else 'Linear'
print(f"  The {better} model has lower AIC, indicating a better fit.")
if better == 'Michaelis-Menten':
    print("  This suggests productivity density exhibits a saturating (decelerating) relationship with biomass density.")
else:
    print("  This suggests productivity density increases linearly with biomass density.")"}
